scenario: Two real Herdr runtimes selected through Clankie HTTP API and CLI
checks: CLI and paired-device inventory agree on two healthy real sessions; ambient session is ignored
Granted input reaches beta only; the same lease is refused on alpha; observed output matches beta
Service restart preserves the selected terminal address and output while invalidating its old control lease
Disconnect hides beta and refuses observation without stopping its Herdr session
Reconnect recovers the same terminal address
limitations: Exercises the real HTTP service, CLI and paired-device protocol; does not include a rendered app journey or model workers.
Isolated sessions only; production runtime connections are unchanged.
